after.excerpt:
## 06 — Upper condition: brace, second K and cancelled lower group

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop04_upper_brace.png` once.

The long left brace has a nearly straight upper run, pointed left crossing/return and surviving lower upright with no conventional upper return. Select the two complete brace runs from C021-G02 (C1/H1, medium; H's vertical bar does not supply this bend). The second K visibly has a transverse stroke crossing its tall stem above its two right arms. Preserve C021-G02a, qualified K with head/retrace | deleted I predecessor plus K, low; A/B ordinary K spans must also be recorded. The live K identity is retained, its extra-run/state role remains open (C1/H0 as new firm-C qualification). Actual C021-R04 remains retained as deleted qualified Sigma_alpha, low: the angular body and low curl survive, but cancellation strokes obscure the lower group's exact identity. Select B021-G02's complete nested cancelled group, including the zigzag crossing runs and low curl, inside the C021-G02 parent; no additional generic strike. This whole cancelled physical group has C1/H1, low for the added literal cancellation geometry and H's struck ill-placeholder, with the actual retained-doubt subrow C0/H0 so the group is counted once. C's firm resolution is not adopted. The K=K1 union {i} wording and its dot/index stay literal. C021-G02 will own the complete upper display; its main roofed Sigma and pale traces are separately pending local inspection.

after.excerpt:
## 09 — Complete retraced group after Or

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop05_or_comme.png` once.

Actual C021-R05 retained, low. After Or there is a dark compact looped/retraced initial cluster, a separate low run ending in a small loop, and another low multi-humped run before the clearly separated on a. The ink does not settle the cancellation/live boundary in that whole cluster. Select qualified complete literal B021-G03, preserving all three parts once. Record full candidates: comme (primary, as C and all readers' primary), deleted co + live mme (A), deleted co + live comme (B), deleted car + live comme (B); C supplies qualified comme without a state alternative. Add A's complete state candidate to the selected group's source annotation, without expanding the literal visible drawing. C0 for retained primary qualification and supported alternatives. The whole H passage Or [struck ill] [live ill] on a : is one explicit H replacement parent (H1, low); any component rows about its cancellation, readable placeholder or absent endpoint colon have zero additional H count. No separate colon is visible after the final short a run. No state is silently chosen beyond the retained qualified primary.
